title: Add New Task
user_story: As a user, I want to add a new task to my list, so that I can keep track of things I need to do.
acceptance_criteria: The app displays an input field and an Add button on the main page.
Entering text in the input field and clicking Add creates a new task entry at the bottom of the list.
Submitting an empty input does not create a blank task.
After adding, the input field clears automatically for the next entry.

title: View and Mark Tasks as Complete
user_story: As a user, I want to see all my tasks and mark them as done, so that I can track my progress visually.
acceptance_criteria: All added tasks are displayed in a list on the main page.
Each task displays its text content clearly.
Clicking a checkbox or toggle next to a task marks it as complete and applies a visual indicator such as strikethrough or dimmed text.
Clicking again removes the completion state, restoring the original appearance.

title: Remove Completed or Unwanted Tasks
user_story: As a user, I want to delete tasks from my list, so that I can keep it clean and focused on current priorities.
acceptance_criteria: Each task in the list has a visible Delete button or icon next to it.
Clicking Delete immediately removes the task from the displayed list.
Deleting a task does not affect other tasks in the list.
If all tasks are deleted, the page shows an empty state message such as No tasks yet.
